name: 44320 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44320 (Akron) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44320 (Akron) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44320 (Akron) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
